result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but one clear data/content defect stands out: an unformatted 'NaN' value in a delivery fee. No other significant visual breakage was found.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card in the 'Fastest near you' section displays '€NaN delivery', indicating a failed numeric computation or missing delivery fee data being rendered directly to the user.
issues.suggestion: Guard against undefined/null delivery fee values before formatting. Show a fallback like 'Free delivery', a placeholder such as '—', or hide the fee line entirely when the value is unavailable, and fix the upstream data so a valid fee is returned.
